defs.def: 除非；除非在 … 情况下

ex.s: Unless I have to be out of town, each week I take my mother to do her   36   and visit the doctor, providing   37   and transportation.
ex.t: 除非我必须出城否则每周我都会带母亲去   36   并看医生提供   37   和交通服务。

ex.s: So, don’t stop speaking when you make a mistake unless it’s a truly serious one.
ex.t: 所以，除非是非常严重的错误，否则犯错时不要停止演讲。

ex.s: After that I poured oil into a pan and turned off the stove, I waited patiently unless the oil was hot.
ex.t: 之后我把油倒入锅中，关掉了炉灶，我耐心等待直到油热了。

ex.s: Some argue that humans and machines can coexist as long as they work in teams—yet that is not possible unless machines share the goals of humans.
ex.t: 用给定命令成功完成任何事

ex.s: For unless we do listen to Rachel Carson’s warning, one day we may wake up to the strange and quiet horror of another silent spring.
ex.t: 因为除非我们真的听从蕾切尔·卡森的警告，否则有一天我们可能会在另一个寂静春天的奇异而静默的恐惧中醒来。

ex.s: Sally Don’t print out documents unless really necessary.
ex.t: 萨莉　除非真的必要，否则不要打印文件。

ex.s: Be careful, however, not to go to popular islands during peak season, unless you want to (wrestle) with other tourists!
ex.t: 不过要当心，旺季别去热门岛屿，除非你想和其他游客（挤）在一起！

ex.s: People aren't really themselves unless you talk with them face to face.
ex.t: 除非你与人们面对面交谈，否则他们并非真实的自己。

ex.s: Do not drive anywhere unless you really have tothe roads might be blocked.
ex.t: 除非真的必须，否则不要开车去任何地方——道路可能受阻。
